title: Siman 287
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.he: שָׁמַעְתִּיבִּשְׁמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר שֶׁהוּא מַרְגִּישׁ צָרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל רַחֲמָנָא לִצְלַן קדֶם מִכָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים, כִּי הוּא יוֹדֵעַ הַגְּזֵרָה וְהַצָּרָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם
segments.en: (47.) I heard from him in the winter 5563 at the beginning of my drawing close — that he said he knows the roots of the Torah from the place where the holy Torah comes from. For there are roots of the Torah which are higher than the Torah — from which the entire Torah is drawn — and they cannot be clothed at all within the Torah. And there are things that are in the aspect of an asmachta [a textual support] — meaning the matter is only connected to the verse as an asmachta, because it is very exalted and elevated. And I also heard that asmachta means leaning — that the matter leans on the verse, as one leans on something. And when...
